items.title: Nvidia closes in on Hugging Face acquisition
items.summary: Nvidia is reportedly nearing a deal to acquire Hugging Face, signaling a major consolidation in the AI infrastructure and open-source model ecosystem.

items.title: Viral AI startup Instinct has raised $350M at a $2.5B valuation
items.summary: AI startup Instinct has secured $350 million in new funding, pushing its valuation to $2.5 billion amidst growing investor interest in rapidly scaling AI ventures.

items.title: Amazon just tripled its order of Nvidia chips over 'surging demand'
items.summary: Amazon has significantly increased its order for Nvidia chips, tripling its previous commitment to meet the escalating demand for AI computing resources.

items.title: The Hugging Face incident and the road ahead
items.summary: OpenAI addresses a recent 'incident' involving Hugging Face, outlining its perspective and future plans, likely in response to the ongoing acquisition news or related events.

items.title: GigaBrain-0.7: Scaling Embodied Foundation Models to Emergent Capabilities with a Three-System Architecture
items.summary: Researchers introduce GigaBrain-0.7, an embodied foundation model that achieves emergent capabilities through a novel three-system architecture, pushing the boundaries of AI agents.

items.title: FrontierChallenge: Evaluating Scientific Workflow Completion
items.summary: FrontierChallenge proposes a new benchmark for evaluating the ability of AI systems to complete complex scientific workflows, highlighting a critical area for AI advancement.

items.title: Annotations as Rollouts: Efficient and Scalable Reinforcement Learning for Video MLLMs
items.summary: A new method called 'Annotations as Rollouts' is presented, enabling more efficient and scalable reinforcement learning for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) processing video data.

items.title: VoiceMem: Streaming Dual-Brain Memory for Real-Time Interaction
items.summary: VoiceMem introduces a novel streaming dual-brain memory system designed to facilitate real-time interaction with AI, enhancing responsiveness and continuity in conversational agents.

items.title: Bill Gates - The turbulent AI era is here
items.summary: Bill Gates shares his perspective on the current 'turbulent' era of AI, emphasizing critical choices humanity must make to ensure AI benefits everyone.

items.title: Bringing ChatGPT for Teachers to more U.S. school districts
items.summary: OpenAI is expanding the availability of ChatGPT for Teachers to additional U.S. school districts, aiming to integrate AI tools further into educational settings.

items.title: WarpSAC: Towards the Pinnacle of Scalable Off-policy RL by Rethinking Exploration and Exploitation
items.summary: WarpSAC proposes a new approach to scalable off-policy reinforcement learning by fundamentally rethinking the balance between exploration and exploitation strategies.

items.title: LLM Agents Perform Controlled Experiments Using Simulation Models
items.summary: New research demonstrates how large language model agents can autonomously conduct controlled experiments by interacting with simulation models, advancing agentic capabilities.

items.title: Orchestration is the new challenge for CX in the age of AI agents
items.summary: The rise of AI agents is shifting the focus in customer experience (CX) to orchestration, as businesses grapple with coordinating multiple AI and human touchpoints.

items.title: Inside our 353,000-person vibe coding course
items.summary: Google provides an inside look at its massive 'vibe coding' course, which has attracted 353,000 participants, showcasing the growing interest in AI-assisted development.

items.title: Learning never stops: How AI makes learning continuous
items.summary: OpenAI explores how artificial intelligence is transforming education by enabling continuous and personalized learning experiences for individuals.
